title: Caraval
author: Stephanie Garber
summary: Scarlett and her sister Tella have lived under a harsh father on a remote island, and long to attend Caraval, a week-long magical performance. When Tella is taken, Scarlett must play the game to find her.
readIf: you like young-adult fantasy with a dreamy, glittering setting, where nothing is quite what it seems.
skipIf: you want hard world-building, as the magic is mostly atmosphere and the story leans on twists and romance.

pairings.reason: A more grown-up and elegant story of a magical circus, with the same shimmering atmosphere.
A lighter fairy-tale fantasy with a quest, a touch of romance and a wry voice.
A more intense fantasy romance with a similarly strong pull between a heroine and a mysterious partner.
